nodes.label: Financial Spoilage Loss Calculation Formula
nodes.rationale: Computes financial loss as waste_quantity multiplied by batch cost_per_unit upon supervisor approval.

nodes.label: Two-Stage Spoilage Incident Report Analogy
nodes.rationale: Explains why baristas cannot unilaterally discard spoiled milk: prevents theft disguise and reconciles physical stock with accounts.

nodes.label: Three Role Perspective Lenses Analogy
nodes.rationale: Explains contrasting dashboard needs: Barista (expiring batches), Supervisor (early warnings & pending waste), Owner (COGS & financial loss).

nodes.label: One-Click Quick Login Demo Cards
nodes.rationale: Fast-switch accounts for Barista, Supervisor, and Owner without manual credential typing during classroom demo presentations.

nodes.label: FEFO Smart Deviation Warning Dialog
nodes.rationale: Intercepts non-FEFO batch selections by barista, forcing justification modal and reason logging to reduce inventory shrinkage.

nodes.label: Traffic Light Early Warning Expiry System
nodes.norm_label: traffic light early warning expiry system
nodes.rationale: Categorizes inventory batches into Safe (>7d), Warning (3-7d), and Critical (<3d) to guarantee food safety and prevent spoilage.
